beauticonfig.partitiontemplate:
<!-- site model. proportionInvariant must stay 0: ReadCountTreeLikelihood rejects a non-zero value, which would add an unscaled term to constant-pattern root slots --> <plugin spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.sitemodel.SiteModel' id="SiteModel.s:$(n)" gammaCategoryCount='0'> <substModel spec='phylonco.beast.evolution.substitutionmodel.GT16' id='GT16.s:$(n)'> <nucRates id='gt16Rates.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam' domain='PositiveReal' dimension='6' keys='AC AG AT CG CT GT'>0.16666666666666666</nucRates> <frequencies id='estimatedFreqs.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.substitutionmodel.Frequencies'> <frequencies id='freqParameter.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.SimplexParam' dimension='16'>0.0625</frequencies> </frequencies> </substModel> <proportionInvariant spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="UnitInterval" id='proportionInvariant.s:$(n)' value='0.0' estimate='false'/> <mutationRate spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" id='mutationRate.s:$(n)' value='1.0' estimate='false'/> <shape spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" id='gammaShape.s:$(n)' value='1.0' estimate='false'/> </plugin>
<!-- read-count model parameters. s carries one size factor per cell; it is written with a single value here and broadcast to the cell count by LikelihoodReadCountModel, since a template cannot know how many cells the imported data has --> <parameter id='rcEpsilon.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain='UnitInterval'>0.01</parameter> <parameter id='rcDelta.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain='UnitInterval'>0.05</parameter> <parameter id='rcT.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain='PositiveReal'>5.0</parameter> <parameter id='rcV.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain='PositiveReal'>1.0</parameter> <parameter id='rcW1.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain='PositiveReal'>100.0</parameter> <parameter id='rcW2.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam' domain='PositiveReal'>2.0</parameter> <parameter id='rcS.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealVectorParam' domain='PositiveReal'>1.0</parameter>
<plugin spec='phylonco.beast.evolution.readcountmodel.LikelihoodReadCountModel' id='readCountModel.s:$(n)' readCount='@$(n)' epsilon='@rcEpsilon.s:$(n)' delta='@rcDelta.s:$(n)' t='@rcT.s:$(n)' v='@rcV.s:$(n)' s='@rcS.s:$(n)' w1='@rcW1.s:$(n)' w2='@rcW2.s:$(n)'/>
<!-- the read-count model is NOT added to the posterior: it is wired in through the tree likelihood, which would otherwise double-count it --> <plugin spec='phylonco.beast.evolution.likelihood.ReadCountTreeLikelihood' id="treeLikelihood.$(n)"> <data idref="data"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <siteModel idref="SiteModel.s:$(n)"/> <readCountModel idref='readCountModel.s:$(n)'/> <branchRateModel spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.branchratemodel.StrictClockModel' id='StrictClock.c:$(n)'> <clock.rate id='clockRate.c:$(n)' spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value='1.0' estimate='false'/> </branchRateModel> </plugin>
<!-- tree and its properties --> <taxonset id='TaxonSet.$(n)' spec='beast.base.evolution.alignment.TaxonSet' alignment='@$(n)' /> <plugin spec='beast.base.evolution.tree.Tree' id='Tree.t:$(n)' taxonset='@TaxonSet.$(n)'/>
<plugin spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.tree.coalescent.RandomTree' id='RandomTree.t:$(n)' estimate='false' initial='@Tree.t:$(n)'> <taxa idref='data'/> <populationModel id='ConstantPopulation0.t:$(n)' spec='ConstantPopulation'> <popSize id='randomPopSize.t:$(n)' spec='parameter.RealParameter' value='1'/> </populationModel> </plugin>
<!-- default tree prior --> <plugin spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.speciation.YuleModel' id="YuleModel.t:$(n)" tree='@Tree.t:$(n)'> <parameter name='birthDiffRate' spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" id="birthRate.t:$(n)" value='1.0'/> </plugin>
<plugin id='TreeHeight.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.evolution.tree.TreeStatLogger' tree='@Tree.t:$(n)'/>
<logger id='treelog.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.inference.Logger' logEvery="1000" fileName="$(filebase)-$(tree).trees" mode='tree'> <log id='TreeWithMetaDataLogger.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.TreeWithMetaDataLogger' tree='@Tree.t:$(n)'/> </logger>
<!-- priors --> <distribution id='rcEpsilonPrior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Beta' param='@rcEpsilon.s:$(n)'> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0" estimate="false"/> <beta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="30.0" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id='rcDeltaPrior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Beta' param='@rcDelta.s:$(n)'> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="3.0" estimate="false"/> <beta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="40.0" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id='rcTPrior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' param='@rcT.s:$(n)'> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="1.702" estimate="false"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.8671" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id='rcVPrior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' param='@rcV.s:$(n)'> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="0.8" estimate="false"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.475" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id='rcW1Prior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' param='@rcW1.s:$(n)'> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="4.6" estimate="false"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.25" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id='rcW2Prior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal' param='@rcW2.s:$(n)'> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="0.9" estimate="false"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.25" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id='rcSPrior.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.IID' param='@rcS.s:$(n)'> <distr spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.LogNormal'> <M spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="0.2" estimate="false"/> <S spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.72" estimate="false"/> </distr> </distribution> <distribution id='YuleBirthRatePrior.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Gamma' param='@birthRate.t:$(n)'> <alpha spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="Real" value="0.01" estimate="false"/> <theta spec="beast.base.spec.inference.parameter.RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="100.0" estimate="false"/> </distribution>
<!-- operators --> <operator id='rcEpsilonScaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="2" parameter="@rcEpsilon.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='rcDeltaScaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="2" parameter="@rcDelta.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='rcTScaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="1" parameter="@rcT.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='rcVScaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="1" parameter="@rcV.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='rcW1Scaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="1" parameter="@rcW1.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='rcW2Scaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="1" parameter="@rcW2.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='rcSScaler.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.8" weight="3" parameter="@rcS.s:$(n)"/> <operator id='gt16RatesExchanger.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.DeltaExchangeOperator' delta='0.16' weight='2' parameter='@gt16Rates.s:$(n)'/> <operator id='gt16FreqsExchanger.s:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.DeltaExchangeOperator' delta='0.01' weight='2' parameter='@freqParameter.s:$(n)'/>
<operator id="YuleModelTreeScaler.t:$(n)" spec='beast.base.spec.evolution.operator.ScaleTreeOperator' scaleFactor="0.5" weight="3" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='YuleModelUniformOperator.t:$(n)' spec='kernel.BactrianNodeOperator' weight="30" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='YuleModelSubtreeSlide.t:$(n)' spec='kernel.BactrianSubtreeSlide' weight="15" size="1.0" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='YuleModelNarrow.t:$(n)' spec='Exchange' isNarrow='true' weight="15" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='YuleModelWide.t:$(n)' spec='Exchange' isNarrow='false' weight="3" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id='YuleModelWilsonBalding.t:$(n)' spec='WilsonBalding' weight="3" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"/> <scale id='YuleBirthRateScaler.t:$(n)' spec='beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator' scaleFactor="0.75" weight="3" parameter="@birthRate.t:$(n)"/>

beauticonfig.subtemplate: <tree spec='beast.base.evolution.tree.coalescent.RandomTree' id='RandomTree.t:$(n)' estimate='false' initial="@Tree.t:$(n)"> <taxa idref='data'/> <populationModel id='ConstantPopulation0.t:$(n)' spec='ConstantPopulation'> <popSize id='randomPopSize.t:$(n)' spec='parameter.RealParameter' value='1'/> </populationModel> </tree>

<run spec="beast.base.inference.MCMC" id="mcmc" chainLength="10000000"> <operatorschedule id="OperatorSchedule" spec="OperatorSchedule"/> <state storeEvery='5000' id='state'> </state>
<distribution spec="CompoundDistribution" id="posterior"> <distribution spec="CompoundDistribution" id="prior"> </distribution> <distribution spec="CompoundDistribution" id="likelihood" useThreads="true"> </distribution> </distribution>
<logger id='tracelog' logEvery="1000" fileName="$(filebase).log" sort="smart" sanitiseHeaders='true'> <model idref='posterior'/> <log idref="posterior"/> <log idref="likelihood"/> <log idref="prior"/> </logger>
<logger id='screenlog' logEvery="1000"> <!--model idref='posterior'/--> <log idref="posterior"/> <!--this ESS is computed solely based on the current BEAST run (not the chain)--> <!--<ESS spec='ESS' name='log' arg="@posterior"/>--> <log idref="likelihood"/> <log idref="prior"/> </logger> </run>
